claims.text: npm trusted publishing requires compatible GitHub-hosted OIDC infrastructure and supplies provenance for qualifying public packages.
A release rehearsal must verify the packed/published artifact and attestation without moving the stable latest tag.
Conditional exports must map ESM and CommonJS consumers to loader-compatible files and matching declarations.
Changesets fixed and linked groups have materially different publication behavior and require an explicit policy.
React hydration still requires deterministic server/client inputs even with improved diagnostics.
Vite 8 uses Rolldown/Oxc and requires configuration migration rather than a version-only bump.
Next App Router defaults to Server Components and needs explicit serializable client boundaries for Zustand state.
Async Server Component behavior is most reliably certified with E2E tests.
A2UI v0.9.1 is the current stable baseline; v1 is not the stable release contract.
Official rendering does not replace transport authentication or application action authorization.
Flutter genui can demonstrate A2UI v0.9 but must remain explicitly experimental.
Riverpod 3 retry/pause behavior and Flutter package quality requirements need explicit policies and tests.
Tauri 2 supports shared desktop/mobile code, but distribution certification is distinct from signing/store authority.
Docusaurus can be deployed as a GitHub Pages artifact through a least-privilege custom workflow.
Visual baselines require a pinned rendering environment.
Playwright traces are preferred CI diagnostics while video and screenshots provide review receipts.
